thread:
maria_ux: Hey folks — noticed the console's 'route policy' chart spiked yesterday but SDK-side telemetry (our client headers) doesn't show the same jump. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/route-policy

alex_platform: Hmm, which metric? is this the 'requests routed to fallback' or the 'priority downgrade' chart?

maria_ux: 'fallback count' per model-route. Console shows +3x between 02:00–03:00 UTC. SDK sampling shows flat. canary was running around that time.

jyoti_sre: Did we change header shape in the python/ts SDKs recently? the routing proxy matches on `x-rw-route` exact keys.

samir_devex: We shipped python SDK 0.18.0 last week — it moved route metadata from `x-rw-route` -> `x-rw-route-meta` (compact json) to avoid long headers. Proxy didn't accept the new key.

alex_platform: Oh. So proxy (and console aggregation) still parsing old header and falling back to default route, which increments fallback count. SDK telemetry pipeline reads headers it emits (so it shows new key and thinks nothing changed). mismatch explained.

maria_ux: Oof. can we add a tolerant parser to the proxy to accept `x-rw-route-meta`? Quick patch would stop the false-positive in the console.

jyoti_sre: I can hotfix proxy to check both keys and normalize to canonical route tag. patch:
```bash
# proxy pseudo
route = req.headers.get('x-rw-route') or req.headers.get('x-rw-route-meta')
if route and route.startswith('{'):
  route = json.loads(route).get('route')
```

samir_devex: Also need to update console ETL so historical counts aren't double-counted. we should mark the spike as 'instrumentation noise' and not alert on it.

alex_platform: Agree. Proposed immediate steps: 1) jyoti → roll patch to proxy (hotfix, canary then prod) 2) samir → add ETL normalization and tag the timeframe 3) samir/maria → update incident note + suppress pager for this rule for 24h 4) samir/samir_devex? (typo) → revert SDK docs until we have a dep-safe header migration guide.

jyoti_sre: starting hotfix now, pushing canary to eu-west-1. deploy-bot: Deployment started for service=route-proxy canary=eu-west-1 user=jyoti_sre

deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded for service=route-proxy canary=eu-west-1 revision=de9f3a1

maria_ux: thanks. once proxy is live i'll re-run the dashboard aggregation to confirm spike disappears.

samir_devex: I'll draft a short SDK compat note: mention header rename, migration flag (opt-in), and emphasize console parity tests. put on PR for docs.

alex_platform: Long-term we should add unit/integ test that exercises console ETL vs SDK emitted headers on a small synthetic workload to avoid drift. filing ticket: https://redwood.ai/issue/RW-1297

maria_ux: perfect — and can we add a dashboard annotation for the canary window so future folks know this was instrumentation noise?

jyoti_sre: done — annotated 2024-05-12 02:00-03:30 UTC with 'sdk header migration canary'.

samir_devex: PR for docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/482 — please review.

alex_platform: closing loop: proxy hotfix live, ETL normalization in progress, docs PR open. thanks team :thumbsup:
